demos.note: The heat haze street demo, passed by the owner as FINAL (2026-11-26). On its standalone disc, do not press A+B+X+Y; on this disc (and the suite's) A+B+X+Y is the way back to the menu. No build command: the ELF is the one the owner passed, kept as built (an ignored build folder; never rebuild over it). It was made by make -C demo/pl4nar MAP=1 RTT=1 GEN=build/gen_map_c7 BUILD=build/pl4m_heat-standalone-25 EXTRA="-DPL4NAR_HILLS -DPL4NAR_HEAT_HEX -DPL4NAR_HEAT_HEX_FREE -DPL4NAR_DRIVE" with SH4ZAM= the KallistiOS one and LIB= an export of commit 82cdf91 (its elf.log).
